output.explanation: Checks that when a report_date is given, the visit_date is present, is not after the report_date, and is at most 10 days (240 hours) before it. A missing report_date is accepted without further checks.
fails_when: report_date is present but visit_date is missing
report_date is more than 10 days (240 hours) after visit_date

Surprising: the expression appends the text "T00:00:00Z" to report_date and visit_date with +. If these columns are true date values (NAIVE_DATE) rather than text, that addition may be a type error or fail at runtime instead of giving a clean pass or fail.
passes_when: report_date is missing (visit_date is not checked then)
report_date is present, visit_date is present, and visit_date is on or before report_date (same day passes)
the gap between visit_date and report_date is 10 days (240 hours) or less (exactly 10 days passes)
